summary.text: Mark Cisneros is a Republican state representative from Iowa House District 96 who has served in the Iowa House since 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as truck driver.

paragraphs.text: Mark Cisneros was born in Los Angeles, California.
His career experience includes owning Shop 2 Drop and Bella Boutique and working as a park ranger, a notary public and a commercial truck driver.
He has served as co-chair of the Muscatine County Republican Party, as Iowa state director of the Republican National Hispanic Assembly, and as development director of the Muscatine Soccer Club.
Cisneros defeated Kelcey Brackett in the November 3, 2020 general election for Iowa House District 91.
In the redrawn District 96 he defeated Michelle Servadio Elias in 2022 and Mandy Moody in 2024.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia shows him assigned to the Environmental Protection and Public Safety committees.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Nick Salazar in the general election.
